newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Aug 4.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
The Sydney Morning Herald reported that analysts have revised downwards their 1996/97 year net profit forecasts for the media and entertainment giant.
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$18.01 (-.23)
The Australian newspaper reported that BHP aims to increase output at its steel plant in Delta, Ohio.
Shares in embattled food wholesaler will continue to come under the spotlight as investors digest last week's A$262 million write-down and management reshuffle.
Shares in beverage group to remain active ahead of Wednesday's first half profit annoucement.
The Melbourne-based industrial group is to release its first half results on Tuesday.
* QNI Ltd Last traded at A$2.50 on Tuesday

QNI is expected to release later on Monday an independent report into its A$2.3 billion merger plan with South African miner Gencor Ltd's nickel arm. The report is expected to make a judgement on whether the merger is fair and reasonable and provide more details about the deal. Its shares, which are currently suspended, are expected to relist on the stock exchange after the announcement
